steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction; rank and lot are the available catalog configuration defaults for a forward auction.
Enter a manual title so the test can verify that clearing it triggers regeneration.
Apply the first available auction template; the case does not provide a template name.

Set the product row's delivery location to Plant Name.
Confirm the requested delivery location was selected before checking the generated title.
